description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the RouteParser component of the FastRoute library, specifically testing the 'Std' route parser implementation. It verifies the parsing of route strings into route data arrays and error handling for invalid route syntax.

classes.name: StdTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the 'Std' route parser's ability to parse route strings and handle errors in route syntax.

methods.name: testParse
methods.description: Tests that valid route strings are parsed into the expected route data arrays.

methods.name: testParseError
methods.description: Ensures that invalid route strings trigger the appropriate exceptions with correct messages.

methods.name: provideTestParse
methods.description: Provides sample route strings and their expected parsed route data for the parse tests.

methods.name: provideTestParseError
methods.description: Provides route strings with expected error messages for testing error handling.
